summary: Onconetix, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 13, 2026, solely to disclose a press release regarding Q1 operational and clinical progress at its wholly-owned Swiss subsidiary, Proteomedix AG. The release discusses two peer-reviewed publications on the Proclarix diagnostic test and the initiation of a multi-center U.S. study with Labcorp. No financial terms, transactions, board actions, or structural changes are reported. This is a routine operational update without any special-situation event. As a non-US subsidiary update, it equates to an ordinary clinical progress report.
